PC: Request IV, O2, and monitor including pulse oximetry.

Ask appropriate questions (directed history-taking):
History of asthma.
Onset, provoking/alleviating factors, severity, time course.
History of recent steroid and inhaler use.
Previous hospitalization/intubation history.
Peak flow and triggers.
Perform physical examination – ask for specific physical exam findings: use of accessory muscles/nasal flaring/retractions, end-expiratory wheezing, hypoxia and cyanosis.
Start appropriate treatment: O2 via non-rebreather mask, Albuterol/Atrovent nebs, steroids, (may request Xopenex, magnesium, Heliox). Patient improves somewhat with treatment.
May give IV Fluids, try vagal maneuvers, adenosine (ask student for appropriate dose of 6mg, 12mg, 12mg).
MK: Ask for EKG –student to verbally interpret.
